waves._basis: LABEL COUNT = the set as it appears on the approved surfaces, as changed only by the owner's rulings (the 9 Sep HumanEval/132 ruling moved wave 1 from 432 to its present count): each wave's label is its count field in this file (count_key names the field). wave 1 = the board's graded set with a valid label (original_kept; the label-excluded originals were never board tasks on the approved surfaces), wave 2 = the frozen focus membership after the twin fold (new_focused), wave 2 parked = new_parked, wave 1+2 = original_kept + new_focused. Qualifiers beside every wave: kept_count (tasks with a valid label) and members (every admitted task) — both computed here, never typed. Pages that do not draw their label from this file name their own basis in their notes: a fitted figure names the fit frame from fitting's served stamp (following at each re-cut); a census of all runs names members. axis.axis_kind: live axis: each task's difficulty is its failure rate averaged over the model configurations that have tried it, one vote per configuration (a model's greedy, sampled and thinking runs count separately), refreshed at each newbench landing; a count-based position, not a fitted model
axis.axis_smoothing: per-task Jeffreys (the ruling of 4 September 2026): q = (N·pbar + ½)/(N + 1), pbar the equal-weight mean of the models' raw failure rates, z = logit q; se per fitting's make_wave_views.py
axis.axis_plain: Each task's difficulty is the share of attempts that fail across the model configurations that have tried it, one vote per configuration: a model's greedy, sampled and thinking runs count separately. It refreshes at each newbench landing.
